sloka: माल्यवन्तं च ते सर्वे माल्यवन्तमिवाचलम् ।निशाचरा ह्याश्रयन्ति धातारमिव देवताः ।। ७.६.६० ॥
transliteration: mālyavantaṁ ca te sarve mālyavantamivācalam ।niśācarā hyāśrayanti dhātāramiva devatāḥ ।। 7.6.60 ॥

translations.english: That army of the demon lords, resounding like the crashing of great clouds, went to the world of gods, which was under Mali's sway, with a desire for victory.
